card.statement:
Let $G$ be an arbitrary smooth affine group over $k$. Suppose $X=\mathbb{A}_{k}^{2}$, $D=\{y=0\}$, and $Z=\{x=y=0\}$. Let $\underline{\mathbf{Gr}}_{\mathbb{A}^{1},0}$ be the prestack over $k$ associated to any of the Grassmannians of Definition 2.10, apart from $\mathbf{Gr}_{\mathbb{A}^{1},0}^{L}$. Then the associated fppf stack $\underline{\mathbf{Gr}}_{\mathbb{A},0}^{\sharp}$ is equivalent to the sheafification of the corresponding functor introduced in Definition 1.5. More explicitly, for every group $G$ we have equivalences

${}^{L}\underline{\mathbf{Gr}}_{\mathbb{A}^{1},0}^{\sharp}\simeq{}^{L}\mathcal{G}r_{G}^{\sharp}\ \ \ \underline{\mathbf{Gr}}_{\mathbb{A}^{1},0}^{(2),\sharp}\simeq\mathcal{G}r^{(2),\sharp}_{G},\ \ \ \underline{\mathbf{Gr}}_{\mathbb{A}^{1},0}^{\mathrm{big},\sharp}\simeq\mathcal{G}r^{\mathrm{big},\sharp}_{G},\ \ \ \underline{\mathbf{Gr}}_{\mathbb{A}^{1},0}^{J,\sharp}\simeq\mathcal{G}r_{G}^{J,\sharp}.$
card.label: Theorem 2.14

paper.title: Two dimensional versions of the affine Grassmannian and their geometric description
paper.abstract: For a smooth affine algebraic group $G$ over an algebraically closed field, we consider several two-variables generalizations of the affine Grassmannian $G(\!(t)\!)/G[\![t]\!]$, given by quotients of the double loop group $G(\!(x)\!)(\!(y)\!)$. We prove that they are representable by ind-schemes if $G$ is solvable. Given a smooth surface $X$ and a flag of subschemes of $X$, we provide a geometric interpretation of the two-variables Grassmannians, in terms of bundles and trivialisation data defined on appropriate loci in $X$, which depend on the flag.
